name: One Last Sacrifice
storyline:
In the fractured world of Lith e'nay, an ancient civilization called the Kaerolith once mined a divine
energy source known as the Eternal Vein - until their greed shattered it, destroying their empire and
corrupting the land. Thousands of years later, when a zealous leader named Maevor Atra meddles with the
Vein's remnants, rare individuals called Soul Formers emerge - people who can reach into the plane of
the dead and bind restless souls to their will.

You are one of them. Sold into the gladiator arenas of Naskarr, the last great city, you command
soul-bound creatures across four warring factions: the disciplined Order, the brutal Imps, the
ever-hungry Maws, and the mutating Gelkind. Each battle demands sacrifice - your fallen creatures fuel
darker powers as you harvest their Essence to widen your powers.

In Naskarr's arena pits, the crowd cheers for your pain because it makes them forget their own.
summary: PvP Autobattler meets character progression. Draft your board from a rotating shop. Build a semi-persistent deck and refine it through crafting. Discover powerful synergies. Outwit your opponents in sync or async duels and ascend the Arenas of Naskarr. A card battler without pay-to-win mechanics.
